p: foundation is in the holy mountains: God chose that place among the hills to establish Jerusalem and his temple.
Glorious things are spoken of thee: Though your glorious estate does not yet appear, wait with patience and God will accomplish his promise.
Rahab and Babylon to them that: That is, Egypt and these other countries will come to the knowledge of God.
this man was born there: It will be said of him who is regenerate and come to the Church, that he is as one who was born in the Church.
This and that man was born: Out of all quarters they will come to the Church, and be counted as citizens.
writeth up the people: When he calls them by his word into the Church, whom he had elected and written in the book.
springs are in thee: The prophet sets his whole affections and comfort in the church.
